solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average marks of students in five subjects in class X 

**CALCULATION:**

**Considering option (1), we have **

Marks of geography in 1985 = 35/100 × 100 = 35

Marks of mathematics in 1985 = 88/200 × 100 = 44

**Considering option (2), we have **

Marks of science in 1985 = 120/200 × 100 = 60 

Marks of Geography in 1985 = 35/100 × 100 = 35

**Considering option (3), we have **

Marks of science in 1985 = 120/200× 100 = 60 

Marks of English in 1985 = 90/150 × 100 = 60

**Considering option (4), we have **

Marks of English in 1985 = 90/150 × 100 = 60 

Marks of Mathematics in 1985 = 88/200 × 100 = 44 

**Hence , marks of Science and English was same in 1985 .**
